project.title: Synthetic microbial communities restore ecological resilience against tetrabromobisphenol A stress by reshaping community assembly
project.description: This project investigates how synthetic microbial communities can help microbial ecosystems recover from tetrabromobisphenol A (TBBPA) stress. By examining changes in microbial community assembly, interactions, and ecological resilience, the study aims to clarify how synthetic microbial communities reshape community assembly processes and improve ecosystem stability under chemical disturbance.
